changeSet.author: openboxes-location

preConditions.onFailMessage: location table not found — Grails Liquibase must run first

changeSet.comment: Shadow for location table. Grails Liquibase owns table creation. location-service uses spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate to prove entity-mapping correctness. tableExists works for both entity tables and pure M:N join tables (which have no `id` column).
